settings.headline:
Two days of code,
coffee, and clever ideas.
settings.copy: The Main Branch is a two-day developer conference at the Harborview Convention Center — sixty speakers, five tracks, and an after-party that actually lives up to the hype.

trust_list.text: Live Q&A with every session's speaker
Catering, coffee, and a serious after-party

stats.label: Concurrent tracks, from frontend to infra
Attendees, capped for a real community feel

settings.title: Something for every
settings.intro: We keep the tracks tight and the sessions deep. No keynote filler, no vendor theater — just working engineers sharing what actually shipped.

features.title: Frontend Foundations
features.text: Component architecture, state that doesn't rot, and the rendering patterns that keep large apps fast on real devices.

features.title: Backend & APIs
features.text: Designing services that survive prod. Contracts, observability, and the boring reliability work that lets teams sleep.

features.title: Data & ML in Prod
features.text: From training pipeline to serving endpoint. Feature stores, drift detection, and shipping models you can actually trust.

features.title: DevOps & Platforms
features.text: Kubernetes without the horror stories, incident reviews that don't blame, and platforms that make developers faster.

features.title: Careers & Craft
features.text: Staff-level growth, technical writing, mentoring, and the soft skills that make senior engineers great to work with.

features.title: After-Party
features.text: A waterfront rooftop with a DJ, an arcade, and enough food to undo all the conference cardio. The unofficial sixth track.

settings.title: Launch tickets
settings.expired_text: Early-bird pricing has ended — full-price tickets are still available until the doors open.

events.title: Keynote & five tracks
events.text: An opening keynote on the craft of building durable software, then five tracks running in parallel all day. Workshops kick off mid-afternoon.

events.title: The After-Party
events.text: Rooftop drinks, an arcade corner, and the best conversations of the conference. No talks, no agenda — just the community.

events.title: Hands-on workshops
events.text: Twelve keyboard-down labs where you build something real with guidance from the speakers. Bring a laptop and an appetite for learning.

events.title: Office hours & open source day
events.text: Speakers hold open office hours; maintainers run contribution sprints on their own projects. Leave having shipped.

settings.title: What attendees
settings.intro: We measure success in the hallway conversations, the pull requests opened, and the people who come back every single year.

reviews.quote: Best conference I've been to in a decade. Every session was genuinely useful, and I left with two real architecture ideas I shipped the next week.
reviews.author: A. Novak

reviews.quote: The workshops are the real draw. I built something I'd been meaning to learn for months, with the author of the library right there to help.
reviews.author: S. Chen

reviews.quote: No vendor theater, no fluff — just engineers sharing what actually worked. The after-party is a legitimate bonus, not an afterthought.
reviews.author: T. Mwangi

settings.title: Get your pass, or
settings.intro: General admission includes all sessions, the workshops, catering, and the after-party. Teams of five or more get a discount — reach out and we'll sort it.
